# 869. Reordered Power of 2

## Solution 1 (time O(1), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def reorderedPowerOf2(self, n):
        """
        :type n: int
        :rtype: bool
        """
        def encode_num(num):
            ans = [0 for _ in range(10)]
            while num:
                ans[num % 10] += 1
                num //= 10
            return tuple(ans)

        ans = []
        cur_num = 1
        for _ in range(30):
            ans.append(encode_num(cur_num))
            cur_num = cur_num * 2
        ans = set(ans)
        n_ans = encode_num(n)
        return n_ans in ans
```
